title: CoreWeave业绩超预期并上调全年指引
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's bring in Giluria, head of technology research at D8 Davidson who joins us now to look at these results out of Core Weave.
segments.zh: 让我们请来D8 Davidson科技研究主管Gil Luria，他现在加入我们，来看CoreWeave的这些业绩。

segments.en: So a beat, it definitely needed a beat, Gil, but was this enough of a beat and enough of a raised guidance?
segments.zh: 所以是超预期，它确实需要超预期，Gil，但这超预期的幅度够吗？上调指引的力度够吗？

segments.en: The results themselves are very good. The market for selling computers is white hot.
segments.zh: 业绩本身非常好。计算机销售市场非常火热。

segments.en: Anybody that needs compute is having a hard time finding it, companies like Core Weave that have the ability to deliver computer, getting as high a price as they want right
segments.zh: 任何需要算力的公司都很难找到算力，像CoreWeave这样有能力交付算力的公司，现在能要价多高就多高，对吧。

segments.en: now. They're selling a lot of their compute short term, which is getting them even better prices.
segments.zh: 他们短期出售大量算力，这让他们获得更好的价格。

segments.en: That explains the upside to revenue and some upside to profits as well.
segments.zh: 这解释了营收的上行空间以及利润的一些上行空间。

segments.en: The challenge for Core Weave is the ability to raise more capital to keep going.
segments.zh: CoreWeave的挑战在于筹集更多资金以持续经营的能力。

segments.en: The dead markets, for most intents and purposes, are shut down, especially at the unsecured level.
segments.zh: 市场基本上处于关闭状态，尤其是在无担保层面。

segments.en: They can still try to do some smaller, secure debt, which is more limited in scope and still becoming more expensive.
segments.zh: 他们仍可尝试做一些规模较小的有担保债务，范围更有限，且成本仍在上升。

segments.en: And they're now pivoting to doing equity.
segments.zh: 他们现在正转向权益资产。

segments.en: Previously, their strategy was to only finance the capital expenditures with debt.
segments.zh: 此前，他们的策略是仅通过债务为资本支出融资。

segments.en: Now they're also issuing equity. That's something that as investors die, they're going to have to figure out what the delusion is.
segments.zh: 现在他们也在发行权益。这是市场参与者需要弄清楚这种错觉是什么。

segments.en: So that's the bigger challenge for Core Weave is getting the capital.
segments.zh: 因此，CoreWeave面临的更大挑战是获取资本。

segments.en: The fact that the compute prices are very high right now, we already knew that.
segments.zh: 事实上，目前计算价格非常高，我们早已知道这一点。
